description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 17.07.2023 to 23.07.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/commercial transactions at customs, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories. The notification creates binding compliance requirements for customs payments.
